short: a piece of code that can pause itself (yield) and be resumed later from the same spot. every virtual thread runs inside one.
the heap object a parked virtual thread's frames are copied into (freeze) and copied back out of (thaw).
walking a structure where each element holds the address of the next, so every load waits for the previous one. why linked lists are slow.
Parallel GC's rule: more than 98% of time in GC while freeing under 2% of the heap throws OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded.
a hash map key or set element whose hashCode changes after insertion. the entry stays in the old bucket and can't be found or removed.
one reference from long-lived code into an undeployed app keeps its class loader, and so every one of its classes, alive.
